what_happened.line: The Cemetery Commission heard the DPW director walk through a level-funded cemetery budget, line by line, with a small increase driven by salaries.
Members questioned the supervisor overtime line, which went over in FY21, and it is held level because current spending is well under it.
The DPW director will ask the town accountant whether the family charge for Saturday burials can be routed to the cemetery overtime account.
The commission agreed to continue with a trial trim of the first section of hedges at North Cemetery, paid from the purchase of service line.
The chair will draft the commission's town report submission; no votes were recorded and the next meeting is set for January or early February.

why_it_matters: Cemetery upkeep is paid from the town budget, mostly taxes, and the overtime line shows how weekend burials are funded without a larger appropriation.
If the Saturday burial charge can be directed to the overtime account, the fees families pay would offset that cost instead of going to the town's general revenue.

The commission's next meeting, expected in January or early February, and its town report submission.
